patient_persona.description: Encik Khairul Anuar bin Mohd Noor, 40, male, civil servant in Putrajaya; cholesterol high on a workplace screening. Calm, articulate, mixes English at work.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Jessica Lee Siew Yin, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, family physician at a Putrajaya clinic. Clear, evidence-minded; English-leaning with conversational Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Khairul, result darah hari tu: total cholesterol 7.1, LDL 4.8. HDL pula rendah, 0.9. Memang tinggi untuk umur encik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya dah agak. Ayah saya kena heart attack umur lima puluh lebih. Tapi saya tak nak makan statin, doktor.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh saya tahu kenapa? Ada dengar apa-apa pasal statin?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Group WhatsApp keluarga kata statin rosakkan hati, and it causes diabetes. Kawan pejabat pun cakap lebih baik makan supplement.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's a fair worry. Statin boleh naikkan liver enzyme sikit dalam sebilangan kecil orang, tapi kita akan check darah. Kerosakan hati yang serius sangat jarang.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Risiko diabetes tu memang ada, tapi kecil. Untuk orang yang ada family history macam encik, benefit statin jauh lebih besar.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau saya cuba diet dulu, tiga bulan, boleh?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Your ten-year risk is moderate, so kita ada masa untuk cuba lifestyle dulu. Kurangkan santan, gorengan, dan daging berlemak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Nasi lemak pagi-pagi tu kena buang ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak payah buang terus. Seminggu sekali, bukan setiap hari. Tukar kepada oat, roti wholemeal, atau telur rebus.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik bersenam tak? Berapa kali seminggu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jarang, doktor. Balik kerja dah penat, terus tengok TV.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mula dengan jalan laju tiga puluh minit, lima kali seminggu. Tasik Putrajaya tu tempat yang bagus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, saya try. Kalau lepas tiga bulan still tinggi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau LDL still above 3, kita start atorvastatin 20mg. Kita buat keputusan sama-sama nanti, bila tengok nombor.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Deal, doktor. Terima kasih sebab explain, bukan terus bagi ubat.

patient_persona.description: Ms. Khoo Li Ting, 35, female, primary school teacher in George Town, Penang; father had a heart attack at 45. Soft-spoken, thoughtful, Penang Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ravindran a/l Suppiah, Malaysian Indian man in his 50s, cardiologist at a Penang hospital lipid clinic. Measured and reassuring; English with basic Mandarin phrases, patient answers in Mandarin and English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ms. Khoo, your LDL is 6.2, very high for someone who is slim and eats healthily. 你爸爸几岁 heart attack？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 四十五岁。他那时候 cholesterol 也很高，可是那个年代没有人特别讲。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I also see these small lumps on your Achilles tendon. We call them tendon xanthoma. 这是 cholesterol 积在 tendon 里面。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我以为是运动受伤。原来跟 cholesterol 有关？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes. Together with your LDL and family history, this is most likely familial hypercholesterolaemia, a genetic condition.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 遗传的？那我吃得再健康也没有用吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Diet still helps, but only a little. 主要问题是你的 liver 清不掉 LDL. You need medicine.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'll start rosuvastatin 20mg, once at night. After six weeks, if LDL still high, we add ezetimibe 10mg.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我还没结婚，但是以后想生小孩。吃这个药可以吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good that you ask. Statin must stop before you try to get pregnant. 计划怀孕前，一定要先告诉我。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 明白。那我的弟弟和妹妹呢？他们都没有验过。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: This is important. 你的兄弟姐妹，每个人有一半机会也有。They should all check their cholesterol, and later any children too.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我哥哥抽烟，还很爱吃肥猪肉。我今晚就叫他去验。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Please do. I'll write a letter so his doctor knows it's for FH screening.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 谢谢医生。老实说，我有点怕，可是知道原因也比较安心。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Joseph Anthony a/l Arokiasamy, 62, male, retired secondary school teacher in Seremban, Malaysian Indian; on simvastatin after a TIA scare. Precise, polite, slightly formal English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Azlina binti Ahmad, Malay woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist at a Seremban clinic. Warm, practical; English with a little Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Joseph. You mentioned muscle pains on the phone. Tell me more.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Since about two months, both thighs ache, especially naik tangga. I stopped my evening walk, doctor. Very frustrating.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: When did you start the simvastatin, and at what dose?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About three months ago. 40mg every night. My neighbour says it's the cholesterol pill that causes this.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It can be. Any dark urine, like teh O colour, or weakness where you can't get up from a chair?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, no dark urine. Just aching, not weak. Getting up is fine.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Your CK, the muscle enzyme, is normal, and your kidneys are fine. So no muscle damage.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Then why the pain? Is it all in my head?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not at all. Some people get genuine aches without damage. Let's stop the simvastatin for four weeks and see if the pain goes.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If it improves, we'll try a different statin, rosuvastatin 5mg, maybe every other day to start. Many tolerate that much better.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: But my cholesterol will go up again in the meantime, right? Is that dangerous?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: A few weeks off is safe. With your TIA history, we do want you on something long term.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Understood. Can I take coenzyme Q10? My daughter bought some from the pharmacy.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You can, it's harmless, but the evidence is weak. Don't spend too much on it.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ha, she already spent RM150. I'll habiskan the bottle then.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's fine. Datang balik four weeks later, and we'll decide together.

patient_persona.description: Puan Norhayati binti Yaakob, 50, female, kuih seller from Kuantan, Pahang; loves sweet drinks, diabetes recently diagnosed. Bubbly, loud, East Coast Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kumaresan a/l Nadarajan, Malaysian Indian man in his 40s, medical officer at a Kuantan health clinic. Friendly, patient; English-leaning, fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Norhayati, darah puan tadi nampak macam susu, keruh. Triglyceride puan 6.5. Normal bawah 1.7.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ya Allah, macam susu? Patut la nurse tu tengok lain macam je tadi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Triglyceride ni lemak dalam darah. Kalau terlalu tinggi, above 10, boleh cause pancreatitis, radang pankreas, sakit perut teruk.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ni kuat minum air manis, doktor. Sirap bandung, teh ais, sehari empat lima gelas. Kuih pun saya jual, saya rasa semua.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itulah punca utama, gula. Your sugar also high, HbA1c 8.3. Gula yang lebih badan tukar jadi triglyceride.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Step pertama, stop air manis. Kalau nak manis sikit, guna sweetener, atau air kosong dengan limau.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susah tu, doktor. Tapi saya cuba. Kuih macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rasa sikit je untuk check, jangan makan satu keping penuh setiap jenis. Hehe, I know it's hard.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya start fenofibrate 145mg, sekali sehari, and metformin 500mg twice a day untuk gula.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada kesan sampingan ke ubat lemak tu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kadang-kadang sakit perut ringan atau otot sakit. Kalau kencing warna gelap atau otot lemah sangat, stop dan datang klinik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alcohol puan tak minum, kan? Sebab itu pun naikkan triglyceride.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak, doktor, tak pernah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Kalau tiba-tiba sakit perut atas yang teruk, tembus ke belakang, muntah, terus pergi emergency.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik. Enam minggu lagi saya datang check darah balik ya.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Chin Wei Loon, 47, male, Hakka insurance agent in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah; started atorvastatin three months ago. Talkative, sales-pitch energy, heavy English-Mandarin mixing.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Ain binti Jasni, Sabahan Malay woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Kota Kinabalu clinic. Friendly, efficient; English-leaning with Malay and a little Mandarin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Chin, your repeat lipid profile 出来了. LDL from 4.4 down to 2.9. Good improvement.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 真的？So 我可以 stop 药了吗？I feel very healthy now.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not yet. Your target is below 2.6, because you also have diabetes. So we still need a bit more.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哎，我以为已经 OK 了。Then how? 加药？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We can increase atorvastatin from 20 to 40mg, still once at night. Your liver test ALT is normal, 28.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我的朋友介绍我吃红曲米, red yeast rice. 那个是 natural 的，可以代替吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Actually red yeast rice contains a chemical that is almost the same as a statin. 如果一起吃，等于吃两份 statin，muscle side effect 会比较多.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哇，原来这样。那我不要吃那个了，还好还没买。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good decision. Also, you told me last time 你每天应酬, how is the eating?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 还是很多 dinner with clients 啦. 海鲜，猪脚，啤酒. But 我有减少 beer, one bottle only.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's already better. When ordering, choose steamed fish or soup, not the deep-fried ones. 啤酒 one bottle maximum.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, can. My wife 也一直骂我，现在你也讲，我没办法了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your wife and I agree, 哈哈. Also, how is your blood sugar? HbA1c 7.2, 比上次好.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, 我有乖乖吃 metformin. 早晚都有。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Excellent. Repeat blood test in three months. 继续保持, Mr. Chin.

patient_persona.description: Encik Azman bin Sulaiman, 58, male, security guard living in a walk-up flat in Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur; smoker, diabetic. Deep voice, measured, a bit worried.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Chun Kit, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, family physician at a Kuala Lumpur clinic. Steady and thorough; English-leaning, good Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Azman, cuba cerita pasal sakit dada tu. Bila mula?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dalam sebulan ni, doktor. Bila naik tangga ke flat saya, tingkat empat, dada rasa ketat, macam ada orang duduk atas dada.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bila berhenti rehat, dia hilang tak? Berapa lama?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hilang, doktor. Duduk atas tangga dalam dua, tiga minit, lepas tu OK. Tapi setiap kali naik mesti datang balik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada sakit menjalar ke lengan kiri, rahang, atau berpeluh sejuk? Pernah datang masa rehat atau tidur?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kadang-kadang ke lengan kiri sikit. Masa rehat tak pernah lagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That pattern is typical of stable angina. Salur darah jantung dah sempit, so bila jantung kerja lebih, oksigen tak cukup.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Jantung saya dah tersumbat ke, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sebahagian, mungkin. ECG hari ni normal, tapi itu tak cukup untuk rule out. Saya refer untuk treadmill stress test di hospital.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya start aspirin 100mg sekali sehari lepas makan, and atorvastatin 40mg waktu malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya juga bagi GTN spray. Bila sakit dada, duduk dulu, sembur satu kali bawah lidah. Lima minit tak hilang, sembur lagi sekali.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau dah sembur dua kali, still sakit?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau lepas dua kali sembur masih sakit, terus call 999 or pergi emergency. Jangan drive sendiri.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Rokok ni kena berhenti terus ke? Saya dah hisap tiga puluh tahun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rokok paling penting nak stop. Klinik ada quit smoking service, saya refer sekali hari ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Anak saya pun dah lama suruh berhenti.

condition: Stable angina with atypical symptoms, test results

patient_persona.description: Madam Tay Geok Choo, 66, female, retired tailor in Melaka; diabetic, came with breathlessness and jaw ache on walking. Precise, quiet voice, Melaka Mandarin with Hokkien words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Shu Fen, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, cardiologist at a Melaka hospital clinic. Calm, explains step by step; switches to Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 郑婆婆，你上次的 treadmill test 报告出来了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 怎样医生？我走不到五分钟就喘了，还是停了下来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你在四分钟的时候，ECG 有变化，还有下巴酸，这个是 positive test。表示心脏的血管可能有收窄。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是我的胸口都不痛，只是喘和下巴酸，也是心脏病吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 是的。女性和 diabetic 病人常常没有典型的 chest pain，而是喘、疲倦、下巴或者背痛。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 原来这样，我以为是老了，体力差。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 下一步，我们要做 CT coronary angiogram，看清楚血管哪里窄、窄多少。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要不要开刀？我很怕。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: CT 不用开刀，打显影剂，躺十五分钟就好了。你的 kidney function 正常，可以做。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 在等的时候，你开始吃 aspirin 100mg 早上饭后，还有 bisoprolol 2.5mg，让心跳慢一点，减少心脏的工作。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我已经在吃 atorvastatin 20mg，这个还要继续吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 要，而且我帮你加到 40mg。GTN spray 也给你一支，喘或者下巴酸的时候喷在舌头下面。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 喷了会怎样？邻居说会头痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可能有一点头痛，也会头晕，所以要坐下来才喷。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。那我还可以每天早上去公园散步吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以, 慢慢走, 不要赶. If it doesn't go away after ten minutes of rest, 马上去急诊.

condition: Stable angina refill, nitrate and sildenafil interaction

patient_persona.description: Mr. Harjit Singh a/l Gurbachan Singh, 55, male, Punjabi Sikh transport company owner in Ipoh; stable angina for two years. Booming voice, jovial, frank.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wan Mohd Hafiz bin Wan Ali, Malay man in his 40s, family medicine specialist at an Ipoh clinic. Unflappable, discreet; English with Malay touches.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr. Harjit, good to see you. Here for your angina medicine refill. How often are you using the GTN spray now?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Very seldom, doctor. Maybe once a month, when I carry the heavy boxes at the depot. Otherwise okay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Still on bisoprolol 5mg in the morning, aspirin 100mg, and atorvastatin 40mg at night?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, all. My wife puts them in the pill box every Sunday. Very strict, like army.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Excellent. Your BP today is 128 over 76 and pulse 62. Nicely controlled.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, one more thing ah. A bit sensitive. My kawan gave me some blue pills from Thailand. For, you know, the bedroom.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm glad you asked first. Those are probably sildenafil, Viagra. With GTN spray, it's very dangerous.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dangerous how? My kawan takes it every week, no problem.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Both widen the blood vessels. Together, your blood pressure can drop suddenly and severely. People have collapsed and died.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Wah, serious. Saya tak tahu at all.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If you've taken sildenafil, don't use GTN for at least 24 hours. If chest pain comes during that time, call ambulance and tell them.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: And the pills from Thailand, jangan ambil. We don't know the real dose inside.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay, I'll buang them. Is there any safe option for me?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: We can discuss properly. Sometimes the bisoprolol itself contributes. Let me review your medicines, and we can consider a proper prescription with clear rules.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank you, doctor. Better to ask than to go hospital, right?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Exactly. Come back in three months, and we'll talk more then.

condition: Stable angina, nitrate headache and GTN technique

patient_persona.description: Mak Cik Salmah binti Yusof, 70, female, widow from Sungai Petani, Kedah; lives with her son's family. Soft, slightly shaky voice, Kedah dialect words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tharani a/p Letchumanan, Malaysian Indian woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Sungai Petani health clinic. Patient and cheerful; English-leaning, fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mak cik, bulan lepas saya tambah ubat isosorbide mononitrate. Macam mana, OK tak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sakit dada dah kurang, doktor. Tapi kepala ni sakit, macam diketuk-ketuk, terutama pagi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Headache ni common bila mula ubat nitrate. Biasanya lepas dua, tiga minggu badan dah biasa.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dah tiga minggu dah, doktor. Masih sakit jugak. Mak cik makan Panadol.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Panadol boleh, satu gram bila perlu. Saya cuba kurangkan dose dulu, from 60mg to 30mg, then slowly naik balik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cuba tunjuk saya, macam mana mak cik guna GTN spray ni.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Macam ni, doktor. Goncang dulu, lepas tu sembur dalam mulut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hampir betul. Tak perlu goncang. Angkat lidah, sembur bawah lidah, lepas tu tutup mulut. Jangan telan terus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, bawah lidah. Selama ni mak cik sembur atas lidah je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, sekarang dah tahu. And always sit down when you spray, sebab boleh pening.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Anak mak cik suruh simpan spray tu dalam peti ais. Betul ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak payah, simpan suhu bilik je, jauh dari cahaya matahari. Bawa dalam beg bila keluar rumah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau sakit dada dah hilang, boleh berhenti ubat pagi tu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jangan berhenti sendiri. Ubat tu yang cegah sakit datang. Kalau sakit dada makin kerap, atau datang masa rehat, terus pergi hospital.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Nanti mak cik suruh cucu ingatkan.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Yeo Kok Leong, 50, male, factory production manager in Batu Pahat, Johor; positive stress test, scheduled for coronary angiogram. Businesslike, fast, mixes English freely.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chan Yew Loong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, interventional cardiologist at a Johor Bahru hospital. Crisp and reassuring; English and Mandarin interchangeably.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 杨先生，下个星期二你要做 coronary angiogram。我解释一下 procedure，有什么问题随时问。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK doctor. 我比较担心的是 risk，还有要请几天假。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们会从手腕的 radial artery 进去，把一条细管子放到心脏的血管，打 contrast 看哪里窄。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 是 local anaesthetic 还是全麻？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Local anaesthetic only. 你是醒着的，可以看屏幕。大概三十分钟到一个钟头。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果看到很严重的 blockage，我们可能同一时间放 stent。这个我们会先问你。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: If 放了 stent，要吃什么药？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 放 stent 之后，aspirin 加上 clopidogrel，至少吃十二个月，不能自己 stop，不然 stent 会塞住。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 明白。那 procedure 前一天要注意什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 前一晚十二点之后不要吃东西，早上的药可以用一点水吞。你的 metformin 那天早上停一次。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Metformin 为什么要停？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 因为 contrast 会影响肾，加上 metformin，少数人会有 lactic acidosis。做完检查 48 小时，确认肾功能 OK，再重新开始。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK noted. Risk 大不大？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Serious complication 大概少过百分之一，比如 bleeding、血管受伤、或者 stroke。整体来说很安全。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 做完当天可以回家吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果只是 angiogram，通常当天下午就可以回家。有放 stent 的话，住一晚观察。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好的。我会请三天假。谢谢医生讲得这么清楚。
